provenanceNote: executionModel is the coordinator-verified turn_context model for this revision run.
changes: Fixed a geometry bug: the boat hull was authored under the bridge (parent offset) so the prop overlapped it from the start; the boat now moors downstream at y −2.6 and sails the lane.
Replaced “Look under / Look along” with one control that cycles four explicit handoff states, including lane only; picks on the split or boat/buoys toggle the same state and keep the label in step.
Repair control now moves to a fixed downstream-east test view below deck height that shows full hull, prop contact, pier 2 and the deck fascia; the final pose is retained.
Removed the dial gauge that masked the split and the contact.

Prop is dark steel so the contact reads against ivory piers; underpin gains a waterline plinth and three charcoal bands; the reopened crack now also runs down the deck fascia; the pier split is a deeper charcoal relief, identifiable before the amber “in handoff” highlight.
Railings reduced to sparse posts and one top rail; runtime contour opacity raised from 0.6 to 0.8.

Captions call outcomes authored example repairs, note a repairer could find the split unprompted, and say a full handoff does not guarantee compliance; lane-only caption describes this repair choice; fallback rewritten.

Narrow-screen follow-up: set camera.minAspect to 1.65 in scene.json, so the shared viewer widens vertical FOV below a 1.65 stage aspect and keeps the full bridge and both abutments in frame at 420px. The value comes from the 1280x720 capture, where the bridge spans about 860 of 1280px on a stage of about 2.2:1, so the desktop view is unchanged. build_scene.py does not generate scene.json, so a rebuild cannot overwrite this. Geometry, scene.glb, interaction.js and poster.png were not touched or rebuilt.

remainingLimitations: Authored teaching branches, not a model of LLM behaviour or structural engineering advice; settlement is exaggerated.
Outcomes are deterministic examples. The captions say a repairer may find the split unprompted and that complete context does not ensure compliance, but the scene cannot show that variability.
Reported versus reproduced test results appear only as “results no longer apply” after a handoff change.
Not yet verified in the integrated browser at 420 px and desktop; Blender renders are diagnostic, not browser evidence.
The lane envelope is translucent amber and dominates the “both” and channel views.
